file_exists.rationale: A missing presence check is closed by scaffolding the file from the doc-set manifest, then filling it with real content. Scaffolding alone is a STUB (verdict P) — presence is not closure.

file_contains.rationale: A missing required marker/declaration is closed by adding the real config or declaration the check verifies — never by stuffing the literal pattern.

count_matches.rationale: A partial count is closed by adding the genuinely-missing instances (tests/fixtures/checks) the count measures, written TDD-first.

value.rationale: A metric below its threshold is closed by improving the underlying quality (coverage/mutation/lint) TDD-first until the real metric meets the bar — never by editing the threshold down.

manual.rationale: A manual/attestation check cannot be verified by code (verdict NV, excluded from the score). It is closed by a human performing + recording the real-world process action. No code recipe exists or is permitted.

value:D-COVERAGE.rationale: Coverage below the bar is closed by writing the missing tests TDD-first (red→green) for the uncovered behavior — never by lowering the coverage threshold.

value:D-MUTATION.rationale: A surviving-mutant score below the bar is closed by adding assertions that kill the survivors TDD-first — never by lowering the mutation threshold.

value:D-LINT.rationale: Lint errors above the bar are closed by fixing the real violations at the root cause — never by disabling the rule or adding eslint-disable.

file_contains:D-EFFECTIVENESS.rationale: A missing wired-tool declaration (e.g. a test:integration script) is closed by actually wiring the tool — adding the real script/target — not by writing the marker string with no behavior behind it.
